record.field: The scope "%(scope)s" requires a product on compliance record "%(record)s".
The end date must not be before the start date on compliance record "%(record)s".
The requirement "%(requirement)s" has an expiry date earlier than its document date.
The certificate "%(certificate)s" has an expiry date earlier than its issue date.
The supplier product does not match the supplier and product selected on compliance record "%(record)s".
